title: Among the patients whose creatinine level is abnormal, how many of them are
question:
Among the patients whose creatinine level is abnormal, how many of them aren't 70 yet?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: creatinine level is abnormal refers to CRE >= 1.5; aren't 70 yet refers to SUBTRACT((YEAR(CURDATE()), YEAR(Birthday))) < 70;

prediction.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "__ontology_entity_grain"."__grain_value_0") FROM (SELECT DISTINCT T1.XCL_058 AS "__grain_value_0" FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.XCL_058 = T2.XCL_014 WHERE T2.XCL_024 >= 1.5 AND (STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.XCL_060)) < 70) AS __ontology_entity_grain
